items.headline: $JUMPER Token Sale Goes Live at $75M FDV
items.summary: Jumper's long-awaited token sale has opened at a $75M fully diluted valuation, with Route 2 FI sharing early insights. One of the freshest altcoin launches to watch this week.

items.headline: MetaMask Staking Exits $LDO Validators After Breach
items.summary: MetaMask is pulling its staking operations off Lido validators after an infrastructure compromise. $LDO estimates the exit and re-entry cycle could take up to 45 days.

items.headline: $DRIFT Bounces Back as Solana DeFi TVL Tops $6.5B
items.summary: Solana's DeFi TVL surged past $6.5B as the ecosystem recovers from the $DRIFT hack. A strong rebound signal for one of the chain's key perp DEX tokens.

items.headline: Whales Swap $4.26M in WBTC for $AAVE
items.summary: Two whales exchanged $4.26M worth of WBTC for $AAVE in what looks like an emerging accumulation trend. Smart money appears to be rotating into the lending giant's token.

items.headline: Uniswap Labs Plans $OUSD Rewards Hook for LPs
items.summary: Uniswap Labs is preparing an $OUSD rewards hook to incentivize liquidity providers. A fresh DeFi use case bringing yield-bearing stablecoin rewards directly into Uniswap pools.
